status: exact endpoint-complete carrier kernels, Abel-prefix transversality scalar, and nonpromotion guards; the Xi-specific prefix lower bound and signed count remain open
proof_boundary: This artifact proves the endpoint-complete pairwise radial and tangential kernels, their finite Abel-prefix forms, one continuous all-fiber crossing scalar, the negligible terminal contact-band correction, the exceptional derivative identity, and two exact generic nonpromotion countermodels. It does not prove the q>=1 Xi prefix lower bound or signed successor count, the q<1 multiplicity-compatible theorem, finite phase cells, one-sided successor winding, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, RH, PF-infinity, or a Clay-prize conclusion.

exact.domain: L=log(x/(4*pi))>=50, 0<=tL<=25, a^2=x/(4*pi)+t/16, N=floor(a); the all-fiber q>=1 target additionally has q=2tL^2>=1
exact.pi_provenance: pi is the universal constant in the completed-zeta normalization xi(s)=s*(s-1)*pi^(-s/2)*Gamma(s/2)*zeta(s)/2. Equivalently, with theta(y)=sum_(m in Z)exp(-pi*m^2*y), pi^(-s/2)*Gamma(s/2)*zeta(s)=integral_0^infinity[(theta(y)-1)/2]*y^(s/2)*dy/y. For critical height T=x/2 and the heat-shifted height T_0=T+pi*t/8, the Riemann-Siegel saddle gives a^2=T_0/(2*pi)=x/(4*pi)+t/16. Hence at t=0, L=log(x/(4*pi))=log(a^2), and the fixed-t N-cell N<=a<N+1 has endpoints x_N=4*pi*(N^2-t/16), x_(N+1)=4*pi*((N+1)^2-t/16), so Delta x=4*pi*(2*N+1). The later 2*pi phase turn is the period exp(i*(theta+2*pi))=exp(i*theta). The prefix polygon is only the complex partial-sum path and defines none of these appearances of pi.
exact.coordinates: z_n=r_n*zeta_n, u_n=log(a/n)>=0, S=sum_(n=1)^N z_n, U=sum_(n=1)^N u_n*z_n, e=eta*r_0=(-1)^N*B_0*(T_0+i)*H_a, g=eta*r_A=(-1)^N*B_0*(T_0+i)*J_a, W_0=e+S, W_A=g+s_*'*U, s_*'=c+i*b
exact.contact_scalar: For W_0=mathsf_X+i*mathsf_Y define mathcal_C_N=Re(V_N)-b*u_N*mathsf_Y+sum_k h_k*[c*Re(F_k)-b*Im(F_k)]. Then mathsf_A=Re(W_A)=mathcal_C_N+c*u_N*mathsf_X. At mathsf_X=0, mathsf_A=mathcal_C_N and Q=-mathsf_Y*mathcal_C_N, including mathsf_Y=0.
exact.all_fiber_sufficient: Let epsilon_term=25000*exp(-11L/4)/|f_1|. On |mathsf_X|<=delta_L, |mathcal_C_N|>A_L+epsilon_term implies |mathsf_A|>A_L. At mathsf_X=0, sign(mathsf_A)=sign(mathcal_C_N) exactly, even when W_0=0.
exact.ordinary_kernel_target: For R=|W_0|>=tau_L>delta_L, P+i*Q=W_A*conj(W_0) and W_A/W_0=(P+i*Q)/R^2. The previous ordinary inequality is equivalent to |Q|*sqrt(R^2-delta_L^2)-|P|*delta_L>A_L*R^2. At a real crossing Q=-mathsf_Y*mathcal_C_N; the kernel loses the zero fiber only through multiplication by mathsf_Y.
exact.exceptional_derivative: With k_1=rho_1-u_a, partial_x mathsf_X=mathcal_C_N+(c*u_N-k_1)*mathsf_X-v_a*mathsf_Y+Re(D_(1,x))/|f_1|. At W_0=0, partial_x mathsf_X=mathcal_C_N+Re(D_(1,x))/|f_1|.
exact.exceptional_error: On |W_0|<tau_L, |partial_x mathsf_X-mathcal_C_N|<epsilon_term+2*exp(-L)*tau_L+2e-7*exp(-5L/4). At W_0=0 only the final D term remains.

ordinary_countermodel.interpretation: Strictly decreasing positive amplitudes and distances allow Q<0, Q>0, and Q=0 with |W_0|^2=61/148>0, even for c>0 and b=-1/2.

zero_fiber_countermodel.interpretation: At an exact complex-main zero, strict positive amplitude and distance ordering permit a nonzero purely imaginary W_A and zero physical real-direction slope. The Xi anchor and endpoint must enter any successful lower bound.

exact.prefix_sector_guard: The positive h_k make a weighted prefix-sector or aggregate oscillatory estimate a sufficient Xi input, but termwise sign is not inherited from r_(n+1)<r_n, u_(n+1)<u_n, or the common coefficient direction s_*'. The exact countermodels forbid such a generic promotion.
exact.relative_carrier_rotation: For chi_n=zeta_n*conj(zeta_1), |chi_n|=1, vartheta_(n,x)=Im(chi_(n,x)*conj(chi_n))=(-b)*log(n)+Im[d_(n,x)/(1+d_n)-d_(1,x)/(1+d_1)]. Since -b>=1/2, |d_n|<2189/x<1/2, and |d_(n,x)|<4223/x^2, vartheta_(n,x)>log(2)/2-16892/x^2>1/3 for n>=2. At fixed t a complete cutoff cell has Delta x=4*pi*(2N+1), so chi_2 advances by more than Delta x/3>2*pi and takes every unit-circle value.
exact.sector_rotation_guard: The actual Xi relative carriers are monotone rotating, not confined to one fixed sector on a cutoff cell. Therefore a termwise cosine/sine sign or fixed common half-plane cannot be the uniform proof. Relative rotation may instead be used inside an aggregate oscillatory estimate or an explicit phase-cell decomposition.
exact.live_target: With delta_L=50000*exp(-5L/4)/|f_1|, A_L=(100000L+1)*exp(-5L/4)/|f_1|, and epsilon_term=25000*exp(-11L/4)/|f_1|, prove on q>=1 that |mathsf_X|<=delta_L implies |mathcal_C_N|>A_L+epsilon_term, and prove that the number of crossings mathsf_X=0 with mathcal_C_N>0 is below one successor turn after the prescribed boundary composition. This single division-free prefix theorem includes W_0=0.
exact.q_lt_1_target: The q=2tL^2<1 boundary remains a separate multiplicity-compatible parabolic/Hermite theorem. The prefix identity remains exact there, but no uniform positive slope is imposed at t=0.
exact.chart_scope: The prefixes F_k and complex kernels are canonical-chart objects. Prove the prefix theorem in one prescribed chart and transfer only mathsf_X and mathsf_A through the certified adjacent real-projection bounds.

rows.claim: The bulk radial and tangential currents have explicit diagonal and unordered-pair kernels.
rows.proof_boundary: The cosine and sine kernels are indefinite.

rows.claim: The endpoint-complete current adds one endpoint diagonal and one cross term per carrier.
Finite Abel summation collapses the logarithmic moment to positive gap weights on prefixes.
rows.proof_boundary: The positive weights do not make the complex prefix projections one-signed.

rows.claim: The complete centered slope has one terminal block and an O(N) Abel-prefix expansion.
rows.proof_boundary: The terminal block retains the exact endpoint phase.

rows.claim: Both ordinary Hermitian kernels have endpoint-complete O(N) prefix formulas.
rows.proof_boundary: These are the same radial and tangential ratio numerators, not a new positivity theorem.

rows.claim: One division-free prefix scalar equals the physical slope at every real crossing, including the zero fiber.
rows.formula: For W_0=mathsf_X+i*mathsf_Y define mathcal_C_N=Re(V_N)-b*u_N*mathsf_Y+sum_k h_k*[c*Re(F_k)-b*Im(F_k)]. Then mathsf_A=Re(W_A)=mathcal_C_N+c*u_N*mathsf_X. At mathsf_X=0, mathsf_A=mathcal_C_N and Q=-mathsf_Y*mathcal_C_N, including mathsf_Y=0.
rows.proof_boundary: Unlike the Wronskian, this scalar does not vanish merely because W_0=0.

rows.claim: The only contact-band difference between the prefix scalar and the physical slope is negligible.
A single prefix-scalar lower bound closes the direct projection theorem on every complex fiber.
rows.formula: Let epsilon_term=25000*exp(-11L/4)/|f_1|. On |mathsf_X|<=delta_L, |mathcal_C_N|>A_L+epsilon_term implies |mathsf_A|>A_L. At mathsf_X=0, sign(mathsf_A)=sign(mathcal_C_N) exactly, even when W_0=0.
